draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and practical, like organizing your closet or going shopping
notes: Ubranie is the singular noun for a piece of clothing or an outfit. When talking about clothes in general (plural), use the form ubrania.
Be careful not to confuse this with 'garderoba', which can refer to your entire wardrobe or the room where you keep clothes.
